The alter_existing_thesis call returned two AMZN pillar suggestions. Next is revise_projections for AMZN. The rule requires a metric, a period, a value and a unit, so c5, c6 and c7 qualify, since each has FY2026. c8 (capex) has no period and c9 (target price) has no period either, so I'm leaving both out. That corrects the earlier plan, which included them.
